Rain, Rain!

Zoë Akins

R
AIN,
 rain,—fall, fall,
In a heavy screen—
That my lover be not seen!
Wind, wind,—blow, blow,
Till the leaves are stirred—
That my lover be not heard!
Storm, storm,—rage, rage,
Like a war around—
That my lover be not found!
… Lark, lark,—hush … hush …
Softer music make—
That my lover may not wake….
